name: Imazu 01 -- head-on
description: Canonical Imazu problem 1 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/01/01.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 approaches head-on.
pass_criteria: Own-ship alters course to starboard (not port) for the head-on target(s).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
